name: Salmon & cod fish pie
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with milk and butter.
Poach the salmon and cod gently in a splash of milk for four minutes.
Flake the fish into an ovenproof dish and stir through the peas.
Spoon over the mash and rough up the top with a fork.
Bake at 200C for twenty minutes until golden and bubbling.
